neighbours.label: The word ' aging' as a biological process in cell or molecular biology text; quiet on everyday 'aging' and on 'ageing'/'senescence'. Weak pole (max 4.8) with other biomedical word pieces (rem-odelling, dispens-able) among its top examples
fire: Damage to mitochondrial DNA accumulates during the aging process in muscle tissue.
The study examined the effect of aging on stem cell renewal in mice.
Loss of this gene accelerates cellular aging in cultured fibroblasts.
Reactive oxygen species are thought to drive aging in neurons and other cells.
Protein misfolding increases with aging in the nematode C. elegans.
Caloric restriction slows the aging of yeast cells by altering gene expression.
Shortened telomeres are a marker of premature aging in human lymphocytes.
Autophagy declines with aging in the liver and kidney of rats.
quiet: Damage to mitochondrial DNA accumulates during the cell cycle in muscle tissue.
The study examined the effect of ageing on stem cell renewal in mice.
Loss of this gene accelerates cellular senescence in cultured fibroblasts.
Reactive oxygen species are thought to drive apoptosis in neurons and other cells.
The aging stadium will get new seats, the club announced on Friday.
Her aging car broke down twice on the drive to the coast.
Shortened telomeres are a marker of early disease in human lymphocytes.
With an aging workforce, the factory struggles to fill the night shift.

notes: Probes: ' aging' in mitochondria/fibroblast sentences 0.62-0.89; 'aging well' (grandfather) 0.08, 'aging bridge' 0.04, 'ageing' 0.04, 'Senescence' 0.09. Biomedical 'remodelling' 0.32 and 'dispensable' 0.29 also fire, so the word covers only part of the pole.
